visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a female physician in an office setting, wearing a cream sweater and glasses. She points an index finger upward toward an overlaid photograph of forehead wrinkles. The background features a computer monitor displaying a tropical landscape and office shelves filled with various skincare products and bags. (2) The scene transitions as she points toward her neck, with a corresponding close-up image of horizontal neck lines appearing below her chin. She gestures expressively with her hands while speaking into a black RODE microphone. A humorous image of a turkey's head is superimposed briefly to illustrate the concept of turkey neck. (3) A detailed anatomical animation is presented on a pink patterned background, showing cross-sections of the skin layers. White vertical pillars representing collagen and elastic fibers are labeled in Chinese, followed by a sequence where these structural supports vanish, causing the pink skin surface to sag and form wrinkles. (4) The doctor returns, listing topical solutions with colorful text overlays appearing beside her. Short clinical video clips show medical treatments: a practitioner uses a Sofwave ultrasound device on a patient's face, followed by macro close-up shots of a needle injecting translucent fillers into the forehead and neck areas of a patient lying down. (5) The final segment displays the physician in the studio again, concluding her explanation with a hand gesture to her neck. The video concludes with a clean white screen showing the DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC logo, QR codes for social media, a phone number, and physical addresses for locations in Sanchong and Taipei.
